EUR.EUR/USD: EUR/USD trades down at 1.10280 as broad dollar strength accelerates following hotter-than-expected October US headline CPI at 0.4% month-on-month and Strait of Hormuz naval mine disruptions. Hawkish commentary from Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill, who labeled terminal rate expectations near 5% as not outrageous, reinforces firm policy divergence against Frankfurt. OIS pricing reflects a 94% hike probability for the BoE on 17 Dec alongside a 74% hike probability for the ECB. GBP COT LF long +32.7k. BoE hike priced in.
